items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849, a critical Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that could lead to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Other issues include privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability (PolyShell)
items.summary: Named 'PolyShell' by Sansec, this is an unrestricted file upload flaw in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (CVSS 9.6) that allows attackers to upload disguised image files containing PHP code via the guest cart API, leading to code execution. It was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities on October 27, 2026, and is actively exploited.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0), dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', allows unauthenticated remote code execution through improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine, with active exploitation reported since September 4, 2026. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including multiple stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and Incorrect Authorization issues (CVE-2026-77111, CVE-2026-77109, CVE-2026-77774, CVE-2026-76202). Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Critical Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Adobe released isolated security patches for APSB26-92, fixing seven vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. This flaw allows attackers to switch a customer session to another account without authentication, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento security patch
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48356 (CVSS 9.6), an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could lead to privilege escalation, and CVE-2026-48358 (CVSS 9.1), affecting webhooks and potentially leading to arbitrary code execution with authentication and admin privileges.
